name: Order-tier reprice BEFORE Activate vs Convert-with-auto-activate race (reprice ordering)
expected: Order-level reprice completes (CompletedWithPricing, contributor base + term fields stamped) BEFORE Activate; no INVALID_INPUT; auto-activate path waits for reprice.
actual: Fresh order 00095654 (own): place-reprice Force/Skip -> isSuccess=true, errorResponse=[] -> flipped Draft CompletedWithPricing/Validation=null, PricingTermCount=1, EndDate=2027-06-29, TotalLineAmount=13726.4 (4x3431.60). Activate AFTER reprice -> Activated, no INVALID_INPUT, Sbms=Decomposed. Live flow Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion has 2 OrderRepriceInvocable nodes (contract + no-contract) gated on pricingReady -> Activate only on Priced_OK, else Screen_Error; auto-activate provably waits.
notes: Active proc Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21. SC-3308 fix LIVE: OrderRepriceInvocable (01pWC000002VIVlYAO) called by both activate paths of Fortra_Quote_to_Order_Conversion BEFORE Activate, gated on pricingReady. Smoke test on own orders: 00095654 reprice-before-activate -> CompletedWithPricing then clean Activate (PASS). Side-note: 00095653 directly-inserted order with Calc=null activated WITHOUT a block -> SC-3308 INVALID_INPUT gate fires only on CompletedWithoutPricing+TransactionIncomplete state, not on a null-calc order; the flow always reprices first so this corner is never hit in the convert path. NetUnitPrice/NetTotalPrice=0 on the line (no waterfall net for this Monitor PBE) and header TotalAmount=0 are pricing-data quirks, not part of the K-05 ordering assertion. Power convert fixture failed (line 121 QLI re-query, async-split race) so wrote setupK05RepriceOrderingTestData.compact.apex.
verdict_reason: Order-tier reprice (place Force/Skip) completes to CompletedWithPricing with term fields stamped BEFORE Activate, and the live convert flow gates Activate on the reprice's pricingReady (waits for reprice). Clean Activate, no INVALID_INPUT. Matches K-05 expected_behavior.
